requirements.title: IANY argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the valid rank range; MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.

pending.IANY-ARRAY-integer-array: Use conforming integer arrays of rank one and rank two; mutate ARRAY to a real array as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IANY-DIM-integer-scalar-valid-range: Use DIM=1 and DIM=2 on a rank-two array; mutate DIM to 0 and rank+1 as source-control restrictions with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IANY-MASK-logical-conformable: Use a logical MASK with the same shape as ARRAY and a second all-false MASK; mutate MASK shape as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: IANY result type, kind, rank, and shape
requirements.definition: The IANY result has ARRAY's integer type and kind, is scalar without DIM or for rank-one ARRAY, and otherwise has rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed.

pending.IANY-result-type-kind-from-array: Use ARRAY with a nondefault integer kind selected by SELECTED_INT_KIND; assert KIND(IANY(ARRAY)) equals KIND(ARRAY) while the result bits are checked separately.
pending.IANY-result-scalar-without-dim-or-rank-o: Use rank-one ARRAY with and without DIM and assert scalar assignment succeeds to a sentinel scalar; mutate to rank-two DIM omission for a distinct shape path.
pending.IANY-result-shape-removes-dim: Use a rank-two ARRAY with extents [2,3]; assert SHAPE(IANY(ARRAY,DIM=1)) is [3] and SHAPE(IANY(ARRAY,DIM=2)) is [2].

requirements.title: IANY full-array reduction and zero-size identity
requirements.definition: IANY over the whole ARRAY yields the bitwise OR of all elements, with zero as the zero-size result.

pending.IANY-bitwise-or-all-elements: Use integer elements with disjoint and shared bit patterns; assert by BTEST that every selected set bit from any element appears and an unset control bit remains clear.
pending.IANY-zero-size-identity-zero-bits: Use a zero-size integer array and assert POPCNT(IANY(array)) equals zero; pair with a nonzero-size companion whose OR sets a checked bit.

requirements.title: IANY MASK is equivalent to reducing PACK(ARRAY,MASK)
requirements.definition: IANY with MASK has the value of IANY applied to PACK(ARRAY,MASK).

pending.IANY-mask-pack-equivalence: Use a mask selecting two of four elements; compare IANY(ARRAY,MASK=MASK) with IANY(PACK(ARRAY,MASK)) by BTEST over selected positions and mutate MASK to select a different element.
pending.IANY-all-false-mask-uses-zero-identity: Use an all-false MASK and assert POPCNT(result) equals zero; pair with a one-true MASK whose selected element sets a checked bit.

requirements.title: IANY DIM reduction applies IANY to each section
requirements.definition: IANY with DIM reduces each rank-one section selected along DIM, with optional MASK sections applied correspondingly; rank-one ARRAY with DIM equals the whole-array form.

pending.IANY-dim-rank-one-equals-whole-array: Use a rank-one array with DIM=1 and compare against IANY(array) by BTEST over discriminating positions.
pending.IANY-dim-section-wise-reduction: Use a rank-two array whose DIM=1 and DIM=2 reductions produce different bit patterns; assert each result element by BTEST and mutate DIM.
pending.IANY-dim-mask-section-wise-reduction: Use a rank-two MASK with a different true set per column; compare each result element with an explicit IANY over the corresponding PACKed section.
